HISD Tabs

Tabs organize content at the same level of hierarchy. Each panel below shows every state — active, inactive, hover, focus, and disabled — plus an overflow set that scrolls horizontally with fade masks at --color-bg. The right panel is forced to data-theme="dark"; the component inherits dark purely through semantic tokens — no component-specific dark CSS. Keyboard: Arrow Left/Right move and auto-activate, Home/End jump to first/last.

Copy-paste snippet

<div class="hisd-tabs">
  <div class="hisd-tabs__viewport">
    <ul class="hisd-tabs__list" role="tablist" aria-label="School enrollment">
      <li role="presentation">
        <button type="button" class="hisd-tabs__tab" role="tab"
                id="tab-overview" aria-controls="panel-overview"
                aria-selected="true" tabindex="0">Overview</button>
      </li>
      <li role="presentation">
        <button type="button" class="hisd-tabs__tab" role="tab"
                id="tab-eligibility" aria-controls="panel-eligibility"
                aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1">Eligibility</button>
      </li>
      <li role="presentation">
        <button type="button" class="hisd-tabs__tab" role="tab"
                id="tab-archived" aria-controls="panel-archived"
                aria-selected="false" tabindex="-1" disabled>Archived</button>
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="hisd-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-overview"
       aria-labelledby="tab-overview" tabindex="0">
    Overview content…
  </div>
  <div class="hisd-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-eligibility"
       aria-labelledby="tab-eligibility" tabindex="0" hidden>
    Eligibility content…
  </div>
  <div class="hisd-tabs__panel" role="tabpanel" id="panel-archived"
       aria-labelledby="tab-archived" tabindex="0" hidden>
    Archived content…
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Automatic activation: Arrow Left/Right move + activate;
     Home/End jump to first/last enabled tab; roving tabindex keeps a
     single tab stop. Wire with the script in this demo (WAI-ARIA APG). -->
